node.label: Odd Arne Westad
node.date_label: Decisive Encounters (2003) · The Global Cold War (2005) · The Cold War:A World History (2017)
node.description: International historian whose Cold War research places superpower conflict within global ideological competition and postcolonial transformations. Westad’s account follows interventions beyond Europe and examines how capitalism and socialism shaped choices. His2017 explanation emphasizes newly accessible sources and synthesis across regional scholarship; global scope does not make local actors passive or every present rivalry a repeated Cold War.
